title: 4 Hour Self-Guided Electric Bike Tour or Rental
includes: Hotel pick up and drop off (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Optional Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) is available upon request at check-in and costs approximately $19
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Get ready for an exciting adventure exploring all of San Diego's greatest sights with our easy-to-use E-bikes! Create your own journey through San Diego or take a self-guided tour, either way, you will get the chance to visit the beach, balboa park, downtown, oldtown and so much more! Our E-bikes will make your journey unforgettable and give you the opportunity to see San Diego's greatest sights. Our self-guided tour will give you more than enough time to park your E-bike, tour the Maritime Museum and check out all of the ships. You'll get the chance to navigate through the unique Horton Plaza Mall, and the Gaslamp Quarter to see all the sights of Downtown. From there, you can peruse Balboa Park on foot and really take in the sights and sounds. You can even go to one of the many other museums and stop to smell the roses in the Rose Garden with over 800 different varieties. Your adventure awaits!
